notes.title: v0.6.9 Released - SAGE Exhibition Build
notes.content:
What a fantastic weekend at SAGE 2025! We had a great time and want to give a huge thanks to everybody who came. What better way to continue the celebrations than to share the exhibition build with our Kickstarter backers!

Outside of running the booth, the team has been hard at work with the back-end rework. While we put the finishing touches on that, we wanted to make sure we give our new Kickstarter Alpha testers access as soon as possible! 

Here are the patch notes for the player-facing changes in the exhibition build:

UI/UX update

 Added previews to Refiner that allow players to see the outcome of a valid Refine operation
 Touch ups to the overarching aesthetic and UX of Workshop, Merchant, Combiner, Refiner and Settings UI screens
 Streamlined the UX of the Repair and Salvage slider windows

Environment Decal and Terrain Painting

 Various decals added to Act 1 and 2 scenes
 Terrain painting and set dressing refinements for Act 1 scenes

Audio:

 All Narrative music is now "muffled" (using EQ) to be less distracting while reading.


Thank you for continuing to follow us on our journey, and keep an eye out for future updates...

notes.title: v0.6.8 Update - Final week of Kickstarter!
notes.content:
We're into the final week of our Kickstarter campaign now, and what better way to celebrate than a patch for the game!

Before we get into the details, we also have a new set of Kickstarter reward tiers that will allow us to ship you physical goods! You can find out more here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/foxandshadow/fox-and-shadow/posts/4249659

Without further ado, here are the patch notes:

 Card visuals have been updated to show icons for any Directives and Traits present
 Damage calculations now round down, rather than to the nearest whole number
 The Merchant now offers a Salvage Station instead of a Repair Station
HP can be traded in to receive Scrap 
 HotShot starting Traits now only include Angry (Insult has been removed)
 The moveset for the Rough Trait has been added

 Added Cannonball:
"Deal 4 damage. Deal 1 additional damage for every Swarm you have. / Deal 6 damage. Deal 1 additional damage for every Swarm you have." 
 Added Detonate:
"Remove all stacks of Swarm. Deal 1 Damage and apply 1 Melt per Swarm removed. / Remove all stacks of Swarm. Deal 1 Damage and apply 2 Melt per Swarm removed."
 Added Siren:
"Gain 1 Output and 2 Swarm. Deplete. / Gain 2 Output and 3 Swarm. Deplete."
 Added Decoy:
"Gain 2 Shields. Gain 4 additional Shields for each stack of Swarm. Remove all Swarm. / Gain 3 Shields. Gain 6 additional Shields for each stack of Swarm. Remove all Swarm."

 Swarm now has a Limit of 16 stacks by default

 New UI to display Swarm stacks
 Updated Symbol:
3 Energy
"Double your Swarm Limit. Deplete / Triple your Swarm Limit. Deplete." 
 Updated Jury Rig:
"Gain 3 Shield Generator. / Gain 5 Shield Generator."
 Updated Mob:
"Gain 3 Melt. Gain Swarm equal to your Melt. / Gain 3 Melt. Gain Swarm equal to double your Melt." 

 Added Berserk status, changed Unruly set to revolve around Berserk:
Increases damage dealt and received by 10% per stack. Decays by half when the turn begins

 Updated Headbutt:
"Deal 7 damage. Gain 2 Berserk. / Deal 11 damage. Gain 3 Berserk."
 Updated Hyperbeam:
"Deal 15 damage, apply 3 Melt. Gain 5 Berserk.  / Deal 20 damage, apply 5 Melt. Gain 5 Berserk."
 Updated Overwhelm:
"Gain 2 Swarm. For every 2 Swarm you have, gain 1 stack of Berserk. / Gain 2 Swarm. For every Swarm you have, gain 1 Berserk."
 Updated Firewall status:
"When damage is done to your shields, gain Shields and Berserk."

 Updated Cheapshot:
"Deal 7 dmg, if target is Weak draw a card / Deal 10 dmg, if target is Weak draw a card"
 Updated Heatsink:
"Transfer your Melt to a random enemy, gain Shields equal to Melt / Transfer your Melt to a target, gain Shields equal to double the removed Melt"
 Updated Reprogram:
"The first time you gain Swarm on a turn, gain 1 Energy / The first time you gain Swarm on a turn, gain 2 Energy"
 Updated Rollout:
"Deal 6 damage to an enemy, then 4 damage to every enemy / Deal 8 damage to an enemy, then 6 damage to every enemy"
 Updated Blinding Shield:
"Apply 2 Weak to all enemies, gain 3 Shield / Apply 3 Weak to all enemies, gain 5 Shield"
 Updated Deflector:
"Deal damage equal to Shields / Deal damage equal to Shields + 5"
 Update Screech:
"Gain 2 Swarm, convert all enemies Weak into Vulnerable / Gain 3 Swarm, convert all enemies Weak into Vulnerable"

 Updated Rex's move set
 Updated Bullhorn's move set
 Adds new visual effects and animations for Rex

 Run seed is now randomised by default
 Card Combiner and Settings button are more prominent
 Card combiner should no longer fail to update the UI for newly combined cards
 Map islands are now forcibly connected, so there should no longer be seeds where any tiles are unreachable
 Fix a bug where gameplay mechanics were being affected by failing animations

notes.title: Kickstarter Update! v0.6.7
notes.content:
Hey there folks!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone for all the amazing support and feedback throughout these first few days of our Kickstarter campaign. We’ve just reached 33% funded on the 3rd day! It's been a fairly hectic month for the team between exhibiting at conventions and preparing for Kickstarter, but right now everyone is brimming with excitement to add cool new features to the game that we think you'll love.

That said, before we get too carried away we think it is really important that we try and address some of the feedback and bug reports that have been submitted to us. We really appreciate these, so it's important to us that we try and act on them as soon as we can!

There'll be plenty more fixes and additions coming very soon, but for now here are the fixes going live:

v0.6.7 patch notes

 The Reprogram status now draws cards equal to its stack amount, and so the Upgraded Reprogram card is now working as intended.
 Karmic Shot now causes the performing player to draw cards rather than the target.
 Upgraded Inflamed now lets you "Gain 1 Output and 2 Melt", and does not Deplete.
 Upgraded Inflamed tooltip has been corrected to match the effects that occur in game.
 Tooltip groups no longer contain duplicate explanations.
 Tooltips should no longer go outside the screen boundaries.
 Tooltips should now be forcibly cleared when entering a Scenario.
 The player's character token will now always be visible when they return to the map screen from combat, the merchant and the workshop.
 Various story rewards and dialogue options have been fixed.
 The Gallery button has been disabled on the start menu.
 Spawn points have been added to environments to support fights against more than two enemies. ;)


Hopefully this arrives just in time for anyone looking to dive into Fox and Shadow over the weekend, happy scrapping!

notes.title: Update notes for v0.6.6
notes.content:
Updated description text on:
       * Comet Strike (upgrade): incorrect text indicating +1 damage per melt, instead of +2 per melt.
       * Mob: Corrected text from "apply" to "Gain"
       * Reprogram (Upgrade): Text now present as well as actual effects.

    Adjusted Swarm starting deck from:
        * 3 Leap -> 4 leap
        * 3 Defend -> 3 Defend
        * 1 Ray -> 2 Ray
        * 1 Signal -> 2 Signal
    
    Added '?' tokens for default encounters, tokens are now destroyed once player has completed the scenario

    Change status turn trigger ordering to have melt be more directly impactful
        * Melt triggers when turn WILL begin
        * Shielded clears when turn HAS begun
        * shield generating effects trigger when turn WILL end.
        * Update tooltips for Melting, Swarm and Shield Generator

    Adjusted Threat threshold on 3 events
        * 05-20 Crash Twin Bit -> 05-30 Crash Twin Bit
        * 10-30 Highrise Concreetle X Journalist -> 10-50 Highrise Concreetle X Journalist
        * 15-50 Pond Spiderpot x Plugsnake -> 25-50 Pond Spiderpot x Plugsnake

    Fixed MacOS cursor bug by changing mouse cursor to 32px to match OS requirements
